name: go-datastructures-mutation-aware-ordered-5ae1
instr:
go-datastructures cannot keep ordered iteration predictable when collections mutate during traversal. Implement mutation-aware iteration for the B+ tree, skip list, x-fast trie, and y-fast trie without changing ordinary iteration.

The `github.com/Workiva/go-datastructures/iterator` package exposes `Policy`, `MutationKind`, `Mutation`, `State`, `NewState`, `State.Current`, `State.ChangesSince`, and `InvalidatedError`. `Policy uint8` defines `PolicyLegacy = iota`, `PolicyReconcile`, and `PolicyInvalidate`; `MutationKind uint8` defines `MutationInsert = iota`, `MutationDelete`, and `MutationReplace`. Give each successful logical mutation one strictly increasing identity, recording its kind and ordered key. No-op deletion changes neither identity nor iterator usability. `NewState` returns a `*State` with deterministic changes since an observed identity.

Reconciling iterators progress strictly forward and return each eligible surviving key at most once despite structural reorganization. Publish one visible effect per mutation only after ordered traversal exposes the result. Its observed ordering, position, and cardinality must be identical across mutation entry points and structural reorganizations. Replacements preserve cardinality. Equivalent insertion and deletion sequences produce the same logical ordered remainder.
